steps.shell:

    - win22cis_rule_18_9_28_4
    - prelim_win22cis_is_domain_member
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_18.9.28.4
    - patch
    - enumerate
    - NIST800-171_3.1.7
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_10
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System
    name: EnumerateLocalUsers
    data: 0
    type: dword
